newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Bang buys Golik Metal.
newsitem.headline: Dah Bang buys Golik Metal.

text.p: Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it has bought the entire issued voting share capital of Golik Metal Industrial Co Ltd from its parent Golik International Group Ltd for HK$149 million.
Of the amount, HK$59 million will be settled in cash, and the remaining HK$90 million by issue of 100 million shares at HK$0.90 per share, it said in a statement.
After completion, Golik will hold 64.92 percent of the enlarged share capital of Dah Bang, it said.
Golik Metal manufactures and supplies construction-related cold-drawn wire and is active in the trading of steel and building products into Hong Kong and China.
